deadline_note: Pre-cycle4 feature lock gate must finish before any cycle4 feature expansion kickoff.
common_rules: Trust source priority strictly: 1) orchestration/handoff/latest.handoff.json 2) orchestration/task.json 3) latest orchestration/results/*.result.json 4) integration_status.md.
Do not start cycle4 feature expansion; this run is feature lock and audit only.
If evidence conflicts with markdown claims, trust canonical JSON artifacts first and record the mismatch explicitly.
No secret exposure, no destructive command, no deploy/schema migration in this gate run.
Every owned matrix row in docs/PRE_CYCLE4_FEATURE_LOCK_AND_AUDIT.md must be marked pass/partial/blocked with evidence path.
Use two-lane reporting: submit L1 fast-lane summary (orchestration/templates/chat_l1_worker_update.md) before final result.json.

scope_in: Chronos persistence and universe render path audit

scope_out: Cycle4 feature additions beyond lock/fix scope
